title: Device shapes
description: Wire forms of the device model. These must round-trip keystone's ports.DiscoveredDevice and domain.Feature without loss — the core's ingress code maps between them directly.

feature.title: Feature
feature.description: A functional module of a device — the unit a rule or the UI talks to. One RGB bulb has several: `onoff`, `brightness`, `color`, `color_temp`. Modelled on Matter clusters but transport-independent.

events.title: Emitted events
events.description: Events have no persistent value — a button press is an event, the button's battery level is a state.

config.title: Feature configuration
config.description: Static per-feature parameters the core needs in order to interpret values — ranges, units, supported modes. Free-form; the core passes what it does not understand through to the UI.

discoveredDevice.title: Discovered device
discoveredDevice.description: A device the transport can already use. The core decides separately whether to admit it to the registry.

name.title: Device-reported name
name.description: Often empty. The core prefers the user's own label when one exists.

metadata.title: Transport-specific detail
metadata.description: Opaque string map — firmware version, endpoint numbers, vendor ids. Carried through to the UI and diagnostics.

commissionableDevice.title: Commissionable device
commissionableDevice.description:
A device advertising itself as ready to pair but not yet in any fabric. Everything here comes from the advertisement — the device has not been interviewed, so there are no features and no state.

Discovery does not remove the need for a setup code: the passcode is never advertised. It only spares the user from working out which device is which.

ref.title: Advertisement reference
ref.description: Pass back in `commission.target` to pair this exact device.

discriminator.title: Long discriminator
discriminator.description: Matches the digits printed next to the device's QR code, so the UI can tell two identical bulbs apart.

stateValue.title: State value
stateValue.description: A single attribute reading. `value` may be any JSON type — bool, number, string, or a structured object for compound attributes like colour.

unit.title: Unit of measurement
unit.description: Free-form but conventional: `celsius`, `percent`, `watts`, `lux`, `ppm`, `seconds`. Absent means dimensionless.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: 0..1, for values a plugin inferred rather than measured. Absent means certain.

attrRef.title: Attribute reference
attrRef.description: Addresses one attribute: which device, which feature, which key.
